common_mistakes.problem: Assuming external services always return valid data.
common_mistakes.why: Timeouts, authorization failures, rate limits and schema changes are normal failure cases.
common_mistakes.fix: Add timeouts, status/schema validation, least-privilege access and bounded retries.

common_mistakes.problem: Embedding credentials or sensitive rows in examples or logs.
common_mistakes.why: Secrets and private data can leak through source control or diagnostic output.
common_mistakes.fix: Use environment-based secret handling and synthetic examples; redact logs.

common_mistakes.problem: Leaving resources open after an error.
common_mistakes.why: Unclosed connections and files can leak resources or lock outputs.
common_mistakes.fix: Use reliable cleanup patterns and test both success and failure paths.
